title: Concrete Mixer 12-hour maintenance window override
gherkin:
Feature: Concrete Mixer Maintenance Window Override
  Scenario: Concrete Mixer applies 12-hour maintenance window instead of standard 2-hour
    Given a Concrete Mixer item exists in the rental system
    When a maintenance period is initiated for the Concrete Mixer
    Then the maintenance window duration should be 720 minutes (12 hours)
    And the standard 2-hour (120 min) rule should not apply
    And the maintenance window should override any default maintenance settings
rationale: Validates the critical emergency override for Concrete Mixers category that applies a 12-hour (720 min) maintenance window instead of the standard 2-hour (120 min) rule. This is the primary exception documented in the operative context and is essential until the official Maintenance Matrix is published.
usedContextItems: Concrete Mixers require a 12-hour (720 min) maintenance window as an emergency override to the standard 2-hour (120 min) rule|Maintenance periods take precedence over normal availability windows

From: ops_lead@toolchain.com
To: dev_leads@toolchain.com, pm_team@toolchain.com
Date: 2026-02-20 14:00
Subject: URGENT: Special Maintenance Rule for Concrete Mixers

Hi Team,

Regardless of what the current SRS (v1.2) says about the dynamic Maintenance Matrix, we have an emergency with Concrete Mixers. 120 minutes is absolutely not enough for proper cleaning/maintenance.

Effective immediately:
- Concrete Mixers MUST have a 12-hour (720 min) maintenance window.
- All other machinery can stay at the 2-hour (120 min) rule for now.

Please hardcode this for the Mixer category until the official Matrix is published in the next SRS version.

Best regards,
Tom (Operations Lead)
